findings.title: gRPC probe cannot pass on this port
findings.cause: container api's readiness probe calls the gRPC health service on port 8080 (the container calls it http), but nothing there speaks gRPC: the app serves something else on that port, such as plain HTTP, or does not listen on it, so the probe fails, so the container never becomes ready and gets no traffic; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Readiness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "10.244.0.94:8080" within 1s: context deadline exceeded

findings.fix: Point the probe's grpc.port at the app's gRPC port, or, if the app speaks HTTP, use an httpGet probe.
